title: What came between Kingdom of Sardinia and Kingdom of Italy?
question: What came between Kingdom of Sardinia and Kingdom of Italy?
claim: 3 documented links lead from Kingdom of Sardinia (1324) to Kingdom of Italy (1805): 0 of cause and effect, 3 of succession.
why: Each record is joined to the one before it by a Wikidata statement (has effect, has cause, followed by, follows, replaced by, replaces), and the dates run forward. The longest such chain from the first record was taken, preferring cause and effect.
